title.en: Which published sprayer matches the interior hydraulic mortar photo?
title.zh: 室内液压砂浆喷涂的工厂实拍，对哪一台已公布机器？

description.en: The Xingtai factory photo set shows hydraulic mortar spraying inside a building. Open the 380 V, 7.5/9 kW, 5 m³/h row first. It names no project and no floor count.
description.zh: 邢台工厂图集是建筑室内的液压砂浆喷涂。先打开 380V、7.5/9 kW、5 m³/h 那一行。图集没有项目名称，也没有楼层数。

h1.en: Which published sprayer matches the interior hydraulic mortar photo?
h1.zh: 室内液压砂浆喷涂的工厂实拍，对哪一台已公布机器？

directAnswer.en: Open the hydraulic concrete spraying machine first. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai publishes that factory photo as hydraulic mortar spraying inside a building, and the matching catalogue row is 380 V, all-copper dual motors 7.5/9 kW, 5 m³/h, 8 MPa, hose 38/51 mm, sand-cement ratio ≤1:3, particle ≤8 mm, 100 m horizontal / 50 m vertical, 295 kg. The photo does not name a jobsite, a floor count or a country project. M9 stays on plaster at 30 L/min and ≤4 mm. A pipeline pour stays on a pump page.
directAnswer.zh: 先打开液压混凝土喷涂机。邢台河北品锦机械把这张工厂图公布为建筑室内的液压砂浆喷涂，对得上的目录行是 380V、全铜双电机 7.5/9 kW、5 m³/h、8 MPa、管径 38/51 mm、砂灰比 ≤1:3、粒径 ≤8 mm、水平 100 m / 垂直 50 m、295 kg。这张图没有工地名称、楼层数或国家工程。M9 仍是 30 L/min、≤4 mm 的石膏。走管道的浇筑仍在泵的页面。

heading.en: The photo set prints a spraying job, not a project name
heading.zh: 图集印的是喷涂作业，不是项目名称

body.en: The factory page in Xingtai captions this frame as a hydraulic mortar spraying machine inside a construction building. That is the whole published scene. Do not turn a column, a scissor lift or a sign in the background into a contract, a city job or a storey count. The spraying solution page still separates spraying from pipeline placement, and this frame stays on the spraying side.
body.zh: 邢台工厂页把这一帧写成建筑室内的液压砂浆喷涂机。公布出来的场景就是这些。不要把背景里的柱子、升降车或牌子写成合同、城市工程或楼层数。喷涂方案页仍然把喷涂和管道浇筑分开，这一帧留在喷涂这一侧。

heading.en: 5 m³/h is the first hydraulic row, 7 m³/h is the next
heading.zh: 5 m³/h 是第一条液压行，7 m³/h 是下一条

body.en: Stay on the 295 kg hydraulic machine when the room can supply 380 V and the hose stays inside 100 m / 50 m with particle ≤8 mm. Step to the high-flow hydraulic sprayer only when the catalogue need is 7 m³/h, 11/15 kW, 650 kg and 150 m / 70 m, including the grout line printed on that page. German type mortar is a different row: 3–5 m³/h, ≤5 mm, 40 m / 20 m. Type 311 is ≤2 mm and 15 m / 5 m. None of these rows is Electric 15 or Electric 20.
body.zh: 房间能供 380V，软管落在 100 m / 50 m 内、粒径 ≤8 mm 时，留在 295 kg 这台液压机。只有目录需求是 7 m³/h、11/15 kW、650 kg 和 150 m / 70 m 时，才升到大流量液压喷涂机，那一页还印了灌浆料。德式砂浆是另一行：3–5 m³/h、≤5 mm、40 m / 20 m。311 是 ≤2 mm 和 15 m / 5 m。这些行都不是电动15或电动20。

heading.en: What Xingtai should receive with the photo
heading.zh: 连同这张图，邢台要收到什么

body.en: Send the material, the largest particle, whether the job is mortar, concrete or grout, the hose length you measured, and whether the room has 380 V. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai quotes these sprayers without a published list price. Do not attach a project name the factory page does not print.
body.zh: 请发材料、最大粒径、作业是砂浆、混凝土还是灌浆料、量到的软管长度，以及房间有没有 380V。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。邢台河北品锦机械对这些喷涂机询价报价，没有公开标价。不要附上工厂页没有印出的项目名称。

question.en: Does this interior photo name a building or a country job?
question.zh: 这张室内实拍点名了某栋楼或某个国家工程吗？

answer.en: No. The factory caption prints the machine class and an interior spraying scene. It does not print a project name, a floor count or a national job.
answer.zh: 没有。工厂说明印的是机型和室内喷涂场景。没有项目名称、楼层数或国家工程。

question.en: Is the same frame the M9 plaster machine?
question.zh: 同一帧是 M9 石膏机吗？

answer.en: No. M9 prints 30 L/min, ≤4 mm, a 25 mm hose, 50 m / 20 m and 380 V/50 Hz. The hydraulic row on this photo’s caption prints 5 m³/h and ≤8 mm.
answer.zh: 不是。M9 印的是 30 L/min、≤4 mm、25 mm 软管、50 m / 20 m、380V/50Hz。这张图说明对应的液压行印的是 5 m³/h 和 ≤8 mm。

question.en: When does the interior job leave the 5 m³/h machine?
question.zh: 室内作业什么时候离开 5 m³/h 这台？

answer.en: When you need the published 7 m³/h, 11/15 kW and 150 m / 70 m window, including grout. That is the high-flow hydraulic sprayer, still 380 V and ≤8 mm.
answer.zh: 当需要目录里的 7 m³/h、11/15 kW 和 150 m / 70 m，包括灌浆料时。那是大流量液压喷涂机，仍然是 380V 和 ≤8 mm。

question.en: Can Electric 15 replace this sprayer inside a building?
question.zh: 建筑室内能用电动15代替这台喷涂机吗？

answer.en: Only if the job is pipeline concrete. Electric 15 prints 8–10 m³/h, 1–3 cm aggregate and a 100–125 mm pipe. That is not the 38/51 mm spraying hose on the 5 m³/h row.
answer.zh: 只有作业是管道混凝土时才看它。电动15印的是 8–10 m³/h、骨料 1–3 cm、管径 100–125 mm。那不是 5 m³/h 行上的 38/51 mm 喷涂软管。
